messages:
eli: Quick mini-RFC follow-up: instead of long strings for hosting/variant tags I prototyped a compact numeric envelope + optional signature to keep metrics low-cardinality and reduce header size. Thoughts?

sam: Interesting. Numeric codes would help exporters and reduce chance of typos. How do you plan to map codes to human-readable text for debugging?

eli: Mapping is in a small control-plane table (code -> short token -> description). Example: hosting:0=HOSTED,1=DEDICATED,2=PRIVATE; route:0=PREFERRED,1=FALLBACK,2=DEGRADED; bucket:0=perf,1=balanced,2=accurate; fallback:0=none,1=capacity,2=compat,3=auth,4=quota. The runtime emits numeric headers and exporters translate via local cache. New codes default to 'other' (numeric 99) and raise an ops alert.

maria: Numeric codes + exporter cache sounds good. We need to ensure dashboards still readable: exporter should expand codes into stable tags (perf/balanced/etc.) before ingestion. Also keep the metric tag values small and fixed.

niko (sec): Optional signature is interesting but adds operational complexity. What's the threat model? If adapters can freely mutate headers we could lose origin fidelity. A signature HMAC by the runtime could help verify handoff origin in hosted mode. For Private mode customers can opt-out. But be careful with key distribution.

eli: Threat model: mal-ordered handoffs or misbehaving adapters could set hosting=HOSTED even if request fell back to PRIVATE. HMAC covers that case for hosted pipelines. Proposed signature header: X-RW-Env-Sig: base64(hmac(runtime_key, payload_str)). Payload_str = concat(code headers + routing_version + short nonce). Runtime rotates keys; signature verified at exporter and control-plane. Private deployments skip verification.

sam: Ops: need key rotation plan and fallback when signatures fail. Exporter should accept unsigned envelopes but mark metrics as unsigned and route those to a diagnostic sink; alerts if signed fraction drops below threshold. Can't break dashboards on verification failures.

henry: Also, keep numeric codes documented in RFC and add a simple code-lookup endpoint for the UI. Reason codes (e.g., PINNED) should also be numeric to avoid freeform text. We can map reason 10->PINNED, 11->EXP_QAT etc. UI can fetch descriptions when you click an event.

maria: Sampling/traces: sampled traces can include full model name and adapter-provided freeform notes, but only if the tenant and customer policies allow it. By default sampled traces redact PII and are stored 30d unless retention exception.

niko (sec): Agree. Also require that control-plane mapping entries are reviewed before becoming 'public' (visible in hosted dashboards). Private-only descriptions are flagged in the metadata so the lookup service enforces access controls. Audit all lookups.

sam: Migration plan: 1) runtime emits numeric defaults (hosting=99 route=0 bucket=1 fallback=0 reason=0). 2) exporters fetch code table and expand numeric codes to stable low-cardinality tags. 3) dashboards migrate to expanded tags. 4) enable HMAC verify for hosted exporters after a trial period (monitor unsigned fraction).

eli: Example header envelope (compact):
```
X-RW-Host: 1
X-RW-Route: 1
X-RW-Bucket: 0
X-RW-Fallback: 1
X-RW-Reason: 10
X-RW-Route-Ver: 2
X-RW-Nonce: ab12
X-RW-Env-Sig: B64HMAC
X-RW-Telemetry-Sample: 1/1000
```

henry: Ops note: exporter must coerce unknown numeric values to 99->other and emit a paged alert. Also add a daily job to reconcile code-table drift and highlight any unmapped codes seen in logs.

ops-bot: Heads-up: runtime deploy window next Mon 01:00-03:00 UTC. Tag @sam if you want it.

eli: Action items: eli update RFC with numeric schema + signature spec; sam draft exporter changes + key rotation plan; niko write security review checklist and mapping vetting process; maria wire up UI code-lookup; henry daily reconciliation job. I'll post RFC patch tomorrow and ping this thread. :thumbsup:
